newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London slightly firmer.

text.p: Japanese shares in London were moderately firmer on Monday despite profit taking in high-tech companies and carmakers and a sharp fall on the Tokyo bourse, traders said.
The Nikkei 50 ISE Index stood at 1,581.07 points, up 3.57 points or 0.23 percent, by 1445 GMT.
Earlier the Nikkei 225 Index in Tokyo shed 261.93 points or 1.28 percent to close at 20,223.82 points.
"I think the plunge in Tokyo was overdone. This was a sell of a big basket," one trader said.
Sony Corp fell 85 yen to 9,850 yen while TDK dropped 150 yen to 8,555 yen.
Nissan slipped to 804.5 yen, down 12.5 yen, while Toyota shed 80 yen to 3,320 yen. Honda was down 60 yen to 3,450 yen.
